response.text: Your goal is to fix the n8n workflow so the full file of about 5,000 rows lands every night into a Google Sheet without hitting a 429 Too Many Requests error, with retries and a Slack message if it still fails. First, I will audit the existing n8n workflow and the Google Sheets node configuration to identify the rate limit and batching bottlenecks during the nightly import. Second, I will modify the workflow to split the CSV data into smaller chunks or add rate-limiting delays between requests to prevent 429 Too Many Requests errors. Third, I will implement built-in error handling with retries on the Google Sheets node for robust execution. Finally, I will configure a Slack alert node to trigger if the workflow execution ultimately fails after retries. I did nearly this: automated lead intake using n8n webhooks, field validation, duplicate email checking, Google Sheets rows, and Slack channel alerts. Do you already have a Slack webhook or channel set up for the alert notification?
